slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video filling Section 1 (absolute inset-0, z-10, w-full h-full object-cover, autoPlay loop muted playsInline). Cropped to cover the viewport, so a centered subject reads best. White logo, tagline, CTA and the Italiana headline are overlaid on top of it. Sourced from Cloudinary (mp4).

Transparent cloud PNG used as the section-to-section transition: pinned to the top edge of the red Section 2 (absolute top-0 left-0 w-full z-[100], -translate-y-1/2, w-full h-auto), it bleeds up over the black hero and parallax-scrolls on scroll. Needs alpha so the red/black behind shows through the wisps; rendered twice (one desktop, one mobile motion.div) from the same source. Cloudinary PNG, referrerPolicy=no-referrer.

Full-width closing video block at the bottom of the red Section 2 (w-full h-auto block object-contain, autoPlay loop muted playsInline), with a top-edge red-to-transparent gradient fade (100px, from #FF0000) over it. object-contain (not cover) so the native aspect ratio is preserved at full page width. Cloudinary (mp4).

Single-path brand mark, reused 3 times: top-left of the hero (48x48 mobile / 64x64 desktop) and centered in the red section (80x80). Inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 120 120, fill=white (currentColor-style white fill, tinted by the fg color role, not by the asset). Supply as a single-color glyph so it reads on both the video hero and the red field.

mechanic: A two-section vertical scroll inside a single scrollable container where a fullscreen object-cover video hero gives way to a red second section, joined by a transparent cloud PNG that parallax-scrolls (useTransform maps scrollY 0->300px to translateY 0->-100px desktop / 0->-24px mobile) over the seam.
techDelivery: Multi-file React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite, @theme font tokens in src/index.css) + motion/react (Framer Motion 12, useScroll/useTransform) component spec in src/App.tsx; lucide-react installed; the brand mark is inline SVG; Manrope/Italiana/Marck Script loaded from Google Fonts via @import.
reskinNotes:
All copy is hardcoded in JSX with separate desktop/mobile variants split by
and visibility classes (tagline, hero description, 'Get started' CTA, the Italiana

headline, the manifesto paragraph, the 'S.P.D' Marck Script signature, and the closing paragraphs), so reskinning means editing markup in both breakpoints. The signature glyph 'S.P.D' is a literal string, not an asset. The hero pulls all text from one font role split across Manrope (body), Italiana (headline + CTA, uppercase tracking-widest) and Marck Script (120px signature), so layout is font-metric-dependent — the 96px/88px-leading headline and 120px signature are tuned to these faces. Section-2 red #FF0000 is baked inline on the section bg and on the gradient fade (from-[#FF0000] to-transparent), not behind a CSS var, so a non-red reskin must touch both. The logo white fill is hardcoded on the inline SVG path. The cloud-parallax transform stops (0/300 -> 0/-100 / -24) are hand-tuned to the cloud PNG height and the seam position. Cloud overlay z-[100] sits above section content; keep replacement clouds transparent or they will mask the copy.
